title: FPS Boost Pack
description: Smooth vanilla Minecraft Modpack for low-end PCs, this boost your fps in the game for a smooth experience with cleaner defaults and multiplayer-friendly performance
body:
## Ultra Smooth Vanilla: Low-End Edition

**What this Modpack do -: This Modpack adds fps to your game with best optimizatons and settings etc you can read below** 

**🚀 Better FPS on weak PCs**

**🎮 Clean vanilla feel**

**🌐 Multiplayer-friendly**

**🧩 Lightweight and easy to play**

**📊 Includes a benchmark world**

**⚙️ Optimized default settings**

## **Recommended for:**

- **Low-end PCs**
- **Players who want vanilla+ performance**
- **Multiplayer survival**

## **Built for:**

- **Fabric**
- **Minecraft 1.21.1**

## 💻 Recommended Specs

• **2–4 GB RAM**

• **Works great on low-end systems**

## 🎮 **Perfect For**

• **Players with low-end PCs**

• **Vanilla lovers who want smoother gameplay**

• **Multiplayer survival**

## ⚠️ **Notes**
• **This pack includes optimized default settings for better performance on first launch**

• **You can adjust settings anytime in-game**

**Built for performance. Designed to stay vanilla.**
